subject: prd/contract-gate
statement: Each of the five checks catches its seeded defect class and passes a clean fixture; the currency check additionally clears only exact, current `design_dependency` and `requirement_service` dispositions carrying a compatible independently authenticated approval over their exact edge, mapping set, policy, and record, and blocks uncovered, retired-without-replacement, malformed, expired, ambiguous, broad, empty, and unauthorized cases.
fit_criterion: per-check fixtures plus complete positive/negative currency-disposition and approval-attestation matrix
